semiconductor_relevance: High — Ebara specializes in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and systems, particularly in planarization and vacuum technology.
summary: Ebara Corporation is a prominent provider of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, focusing on advanced packaging applications and vacuum technology. At SEMICON, they will showcase their ZP300A Electroplating System, which offers high production efficiency and improved wafer/die uniformity, alongside a compact exhaust gas treatment system compatible with hydrogen fuel.
capabilities: ZP300A Electroplating System for Advanced Packaging
